popup.title: Fields of Nun
popup.description: The open stretch of land running through the northern region of [[Chondath]] and the site of the [[Rotting War]].

popup.title: Golden Plains
popup.description: The land between the [[Nagaflow]] and [[Arran river]]s that was named for its tall, golden grasses. During the century that followed the [[Spellplague]], it was known as the [[Plaguewrought Land]].

popup.title: Nagalands
popup.description: The region bordering the northern parts of the [[Nagawater]].

popup.title: Serpents' Holding
popup.description: The grassland located west of the [[Nagawater]], home to a large variety of [[spitting serpent]]s.

popup.title: Slithering Plains
popup.description: The plot of green land that bordered the [[Nagawater]]'s western shores.

popup.title: Naga Plains
popup.description: The green plains that bordered south-eastern shores of the [[Nagawater]].

popup.title: Ammathvale
popup.description: The small open valley separating the [[Lluirwood]] in the north from the [[Southern Lluirwood]] in [[Luiren]], spanning roughly 100 miles (160,000 meters).

popup.title: Fields of Pryollus
popup.description: The stretch of land used by the people of [[Threskel]] and [[Unther]], as a venue for sporting events and grand athletic competitions.

popup.title: Greenfields
popup.description: An overly-fertile land of magically affected soil between the [[River Alamber]] and the [[River Angol]].

popup.title: Fields of Ganath
popup.description: A patch of fertile land in [[Murghôm]] that bordered [[Mulhorand]].

popup.title: Great Vale
popup.description: Also known as '''Asanibis''' – the breadbasket of the nation of [[Mulhorand]].

popup.title: The High Valley
popup.description: A valley in the southern part of the [[Sunrise Mountains]], north of the [[Ganatheood]].

popup.title: Ejen Horo
popup.description: The '''Valley of the God''', a lush garden-like lake-dotted valley that offered plentiful hunting as many animals were drawn to the bountiful vegetation.

popup.title: Rialuil Plain
popup.description: Also known as the '''Rialuil Range''', it was an open grassland located in the nation of [[Dambrath]].

popup.title: Swagdar
popup.description: The '''Outlaw Waste''', a large stretch of rolling grasslands located just northwest of [[Dambrath]] inhabited by several thousand bandits.

popup.title: Conaluil Range
popup.description: A strip of land located in central [[Dambrath]], home of ranchos located in the northern hills.

popup.title: Shaareach
popup.description: A small plain found in the western [[Shaar]].

popup.title: Nath
popup.description: A large basin used by [[Halruaan]]s to herd livestock at the junction of the [[Nathaghal Mountains]] and [[Muaraghal Mountains]].

popup.title: Tashalar Basin
popup.description: A fertile stretch of land north of the [[Hazur Mountains]].

popup.title: Plains of Pehrrifaal
popup.description: Plains on the southern edge of [[Erlkazar]].

popup.title: Schamedar Plains
popup.description: The fertile countryside east of the city of [[Schamedar]], consumed by the [[Calim Desert]] during the [[Spellplague]] and before the [[Second Sundering]].

popup.title: Red Rivers Fields
popup.description: Grasslands of note, north of [[River Ith]].

popup.title: Daustable's Morrum
popup.description: A small valley just off the [[Trader's Way]], bordered on its eastern edge by three large standing stones.{{approx}}

popup.title: Spearsmouth Dale
popup.description: A dale of note in [[Thesk]] on the edge of the [[Forest of Lethyr]].

popup.title: Halendos
popup.description: A large meadow one day's journey from the city of [[Veltalar]].

popup.title: The Ride
popup.description: An open cold steppe land situated between the [[Dragonspine Mountains]], the [[Border Forest]], and the [[Gray Land of Thar]].

popup.title: Argentwing Dell
popup.description: A small valley between [[Hawkwing's Brook]] and the [[Sulduskoon]], roughly shaped like a [[butterfly]].

popup.title: Giant's Plain
popup.description: Massive lush plains inhabited by large herds of migratory beasts of the [[Western Heartlands]] and a hunting ground for the [[Sword Coast]] [[dragon]]s.

popup.title: Shining Plains
popup.description: A portion of the [[Vilhon Reach]], named after the visual effect of sunlight hitting the plains.

popup.title: Field of Tears
popup.description: A plot of land in the [[Shining Plains]] and the cite of a historic battle of [[326 DR]] between [[Ormath]], [[Lheshayl]], and the [[Tenpaw tribe]].{{approx}}

popup.title: Goblin Marches
popup.description: A narrow region north of [[Cormyr]] populated by roving bands of [[goblinoid]] raiders.

popup.title: Tun Plain
popup.description: Or the '''Tunlands''', a region of grassy steppes and wetlands in the [[Western Heartlands]] roughly encompassing the area between the [[Sunset Mountains]] and the [[Storm Horns]] north of [[Proskur]].

popup.title: Triboar Trail Region
popup.description: A stretch of foothills and rolling, sparsely-wooded plains extending between the [[Sword Mountains]] to the south and the [[Neverwinter Woods]] to the north.

popup.title: Lightning Steppes
popup.description: A steppe to the southwest of the [[Dragonmere]].

popup.title: Horse Prairie
popup.description: A land area in the [[Dragon Coast]] that ran from the [[Castaway Coast]] on the [[Dragonmere]] in the north, to the [[Giant's Run]] mountains to the south.

popup.title: High Moors
popup.description: A stretch of mist-covered uncultivated land on the frontier of [[Cormyr]].

popup.title: Fields of the Dead
popup.description: A stretch of rolling hills east of [[Baldur's Gate]] littered with bones of the dead of many ancient battles.

popup.title: Pelleor's Prairie
popup.description: A large, a warm, dry, and windy grassland located in the [[Backlands]].

popup.title: Greenfields
popup.description: A geographical region of rolling grasslands in the [[Western Heartlands]].

popup.title: Wild Pastures
popup.description: A plot of lush wildland used as dangerous pastures by the shepherds of [[Liam's Hold]].

popup.title: Scoured Lands
popup.description: Farmlands abandoned with [[Plan]]'s ruination and reclaimed by the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Grass Sea
popup.description: A stretch of plains covered thickly with tall grass with occasional ruins breaking the sea of green.

popup.title: Barze
popup.description: The remnants of an ancient fallen kingdom ruled by King Barze.

popup.title: Black Plain
popup.description: A stretch of land located 40 miles east of the [[Hullack Forest]] just south of the [[East Way]], once a site of an [[oak]] forest, destroyed in a failed attempt to turn it into farmlands.{{approx}}

popup.title: Vale of the Reaver
popup.description: A lush valley named for its occupancy of devout followers of [[Garagos]], the Reaver.

popup.title: Valley of Khedrun
popup.description: A [[dandelion]] and tall grass-filled valley where the [[River Mirar]] joined with the [[River Khedrun]].

popup.title: High Country
popup.description: A territory filled with rocky moors and grassy plains and hills, bordered by the [[North Road]] and the [[Earthspur Mountains]].

popup.title: White Rusalka Vale
popup.description: A vale that was a ''[[dead-magic]]'' zone on the shores of the [[Lake Ashane]] to all but [[Rashemi]] [[witch]]es.

popup.title: Mettledale
popup.description: A dale of note, surrounded by the [[Forest of Lethyr]].

popup.title: Spulzeer Vale
popup.description: The vale where [[Castle Spulzeer]] once stood.

popup.title: The Bleak Steppes of Haatar-Baen
popup.description: The southwestern grasslands of [[Vaasa]] with its soil tainted and everything that grew in the area – inevitably [[poison]]ous.

popup.title: Sunderland
popup.description: The most desirable region for [[human]] settlers in [[Vaasa]] owing to its combination of soil that could actually support crops and access to mining opportunities in the [[Galena Mountains]].

popup.title: The Dauntir
popup.description: A hilly land of rolling fields and busy farmlands between the [[Trade Way]], the [[River Esmel]], and the [[Small Teeth]].

popup.title: Clovis Fields
popup.description: Plains of note.

popup.title: Kimball Moor
popup.description: A large moor of note.

popup.title: Dwyvach Salt Flats
popup.description: A plain located on the island of [[Gwynneth]].

popup.title: The Shrouded Lands
popup.description: A stretch of land wedged between the [[Highlands]] and [[Meirig Peatlands]] in western [[Gwynneth]].
